name: OmaTube
description: Download YouTube videos, Shorts and playlists from the Omarchy bar: several at a time, in the quality you pick, with nothing left behind when you cancel.

barWidget.description: Left click opens the downloader; right click downloads the YouTube link in the clipboard; middle click opens the download folder.

schema.label: Download folder
schema.description: Finished videos land here, playlists in a folder of their own. Unfinished ones stay out of sight until they are done.

schema.label: Quality
schema.description: Also used by right click and playlists. A resolution is a ceiling: a video without it comes down in the next best one.

schema.label: Parallel downloads
schema.description: Videos downloading at the same time; the rest wait in the queue. Above 5, YouTube more often answers with fewer formats.

schema.label: Videos per playlist
schema.description: Take only the first videos of a playlist. 5000 takes all of any playlist, since YouTube stops there.

schema.label: Download rows in the panel
schema.description: Rows in the Downloads list before the rest is summed up as "and N more".

schema.label: Rows per playlist
schema.description: Videos shown under a playlist while it downloads, the running ones first.

schema.label: History rows in the panel
schema.description: Rows in the History list; it scrolls past them.

schema.label: History entries kept
schema.description: The oldest entries drop off beyond this. Clearing the history never deletes videos.

schema.label: Browser cookies on a bot check
schema.description: When YouTube asks to sign in, retry once with this browser's cookies. Every download tries without them first.
